status: proposed measurable targets; no physical test has passed yet
appearance: recognizable dinosaur silhouette for B2 and Q4
large expressive eyes with finish graphics rather than extra loose highlight parts

mechanical.design: rear M3 screw, integrated skull support, no adhesive-only retention
mechanical.test: record installation torque, pull-out force and failure mode on actual printed and final-process parts
replace one drive cartridge with standard tools after power isolation; measure with a new operator
loaded single-leg fixture at frozen duty cycle; record backlash, fastener loosening, temperature and failures
powered-off engineering samples in six documented orientations, controlled fixture; assess detached parts, sharp fracture and electrical damage

locomotion.initial_target: 20 consecutive unsupported straight-line steps on a documented level surface
2 m crawl with repeatable start/stop on a documented level surface

comparison: No superiority claim against Microduck without comparable physical units, identical surfaces/payloads, repeated trials, recorded failures, repair times and complete cost assumptions.
production_gate: Targets require review against final intended use and applicable market requirements; they do not replace certification or production validation.
